title: Show HN: Py-SQL-cleaner – format SQL embedded in Python strings
summary: py-sql-cleaner is a CLI tool that detects and formats SQL queries embedded within Python string literals, addressing the gap where neither Python nor SQL formatters properly handle SQL written inside Python code.
problem_solved: Formats SQL embedded in Python strings without breaking the surrounding Python code structure.
why_valuable: It solves a common pain point for developers maintaining codebases with long, unformatted SQL queries embedded in Python files, improving code readability and maintainability.
